colors_chrome.name: Colours — UI Chrome
colors_chrome.info: The everyday palette. Used by all commercial surfaces. Source: Planning/DesignSystem.md §2.
colors_chrome.color_primary_info: Contrast note: white text on this gold measures 3.48:1 and fails AA. Pair it with the 'Text on primary' colour below.
colors_chrome.color_on_primary_info: Ink on gold measures 4.72:1 and passes AA. Changing this may break contrast.
colors_chrome.color_hairline_info: Accessibility: at the default value this border measures 1.71:1 against the canvas, below the 3:1 floor WCAG 1.4.11 sets for control boundaries. Darkening it to about #978b76 clears 3:1.
colors_chrome.color_text_secondary_info: Defaults to the darkened #7d6a5b. The spec value #a38f7e fails AA on both canvas and card.
colors_chrome.color_success_info: Defaults to the darkened #6d5949 so white text on it clears 4.5:1. The spec value #987d69 does not.

colors_cultural.name: Colours — Cultural Accent
colors_cultural.info: The Siwan embroidery palette. Heritage moments only.
colors_cultural.firewall_warning: ⚠ Two-register firewall: these colours may appear only on the 16 Original products and heritage storytelling. They must never appear on an inspired-by product. Source: Planning/BENCHMARK.md Part 2 §5.

typography.name: Typography
typography.font_display_info: Serif, Canela/Tiempos-class. Used for hero headlines, product names and pull-quotes.
typography.font_ar_info: Arabic carries equal visual weight to Latin — it is not a fallback. Shopify's font picker has no Arabic families, so these are CSS stacks.
typography.font_ar_stylesheet_info: Optional. Loads the Arabic families if they are not installed locally.

layout.name: Layout & spacing
layout.radius_md_info: Client direction of 2026-08-12 sets this to 0 (sharp) throughout. Every component reads this one value.
layout.radius_full_info: Chips and pills. Also set to 0 by the 2026-08-12 sharp-corner direction.

bilingual.name: Bilingual (EN / AR)
bilingual.info: Direction, type families, numerals and layout mirroring all follow the active locale. Add Arabic under Settings → Languages, then translate the theme content.
bilingual.arabic_numerals_info: Renders ٠١٢٣ instead of 0123 when the locale is Arabic. Prices still use the store's currency formatting.

vintage.name: Vintage treatment
vintage.info: Paper grain, vignette and edge wear. Storytelling and hero surfaces only — never navigation, forms or checkout.

collection_card.title: Title
collection_card.style_info: Heritage is for genuinely Siwan collections. A collection of inspired-by dupes styled as heritage breaks the two-register firewall.
collection_card.show_count_info: Off by default: the captured product counts are unreliable. Check the live value first.

layering.heading: Heading
layering.discount_info: ⚠ Renders a message only. Configure a real automatic discount or Shopify Function, or checkout will not honour it.
layering.reason_info: Merchant-written. No scent-compatibility data exists to generate this from.

note_pyramid.data_warning: ⚠ Only 18 of 56 products have machine-readable fragrance notes, and the store has no custom metafields yet. For most products this renders its empty state — which is correct. It must never invent notes.
note_pyramid.heading: Heading
note_pyramid.hide_when_empty_info: Recommended while the notes metafields are unpopulated.

price_contrast.legal_warning: ⚠ This module renders only on inspired-by products, never on the 16 Originals. Both switches below are off by default. Read component-library/docs/price-contrast/README.md before enabling.
price_contrast.show_retail_info: ⚠ LEGAL GATE. A separate switch on purpose. Comparative pricing is a legal posture decision — get counsel before enabling. There is also no sourced retail price data yet; the figures in the component library are unsourced placeholders.
price_contrast.show_info: Off by default. Nothing renders until this is on, and nothing ever renders on the 16 Original products.
price_contrast.disclaimer_info: Trademark and comparison wording. Have counsel approve it.

product_card.style_info: Editorial and Vintage are heritage treatments. On an inspired-by product they automatically fall back to Minimal.
product_card.show_vendor_info: Automatically hidden on the 16 Originals. Note the vendor field holds the designer fragrance name, not a brand.
product_card.link_vendor_info: Off by default pending the vendor/dupe posture decision.
product_card.show_reviews_info: Keep this on. 4.98★ across 1,212 reviews is the store's strongest asset.
product_card.show_notes_info: Requires the fragrance.accords metafield, which does not exist yet.

product_grid.style_info: Masonry is a progressive enhancement and reorders cards visually where unsupported — avoid it where rank matters.
product_grid.per_row_info: Desktop only. Tablet and mobile counts are set by the stylesheet.
product_grid.show_filters_info: Facets come from Search & Discovery in the admin. The live store currently has no tag, vendor or size facets.

review_widget.heading: Heading
review_widget.style_info: Embed is safest: the list, submission form, uploads, voting and moderation all live in Judge.me.

bilingual.equal_weight_info: Renders at the same optical weight as the Latin text, not as a subtitle. The bottles already carry Arabic.

heritage.artisan_consent: ⚠ This publishes a real person's name, face and words. Consent is a prerequisite. Do not use stock photography of unnamed people — that is the opposite of the model this imitates.
heritage.accent_info: This is the one place the Cultural Accent palette belongs.

quiz.answer_value_info: A tag or scent family the scorer matches against.
quiz.fallback_info: Used when no answer scores well enough. A quiz that always sounds certain is a quiz that is lying.
quiz.heading: Heading
quiz.question: Question
quiz.style_persona_info: Needs an archetype set that nobody has authored yet.

announcement.name: Announcement
announcement.sticky: Stick to the top on scroll
announcement.meter_info: Reads the live cart against this threshold. The store already runs 1,500 EGP but never merchandises it.

collection.facets_info: Facets are configured in Search & Discovery in the admin, not here. High-value additions: tags, vendor (the designer facet), and size.
collection.name: Collection
collection.show_active_chips: Show applied filters as removable chips

footer.contact_info: ⚠ The live store prints its email and WhatsApp number as plain text with no clickable link anywhere. These fields make all three tappable.
footer.name: Footer
footer.payment_icons_info: The live store shows none. Icons come from your enabled payment providers.
footer.wordmark_info: Brand lockup in the copyright line. Not doubled content.

header.main_menu_info: Menu structure is edited under Navigation in the admin, not here.
header.name: Header
header.sticky_info: The live store has sticky disabled. Turning it on is a real change to the browsing experience.
header.strip_text_info: The thin line above the header. Persona prompt plus the shipping threshold.
header.wordmark_info: Used when no logo image is set. Pairs with the Arabic wordmark as a bilingual lockup — the one place both scripts appear together.

product.breadcrumbs_info: The live store has none. Adds BreadcrumbList structured data.
product.layout_info: Heritage is for the 16 Originals. On an inspired-by product it falls back to Standard.
product.name: Product
product.reviews_info: Keep on. Reviews are the store's strongest competitive asset.
product.vendor_info: The vendor field holds the designer fragrance this is inspired by, not a brand. It renders as 'Inspired by X' and is hidden on Originals.

cart_drawer.name: Cart drawer
cart_drawer.threshold_info: 1,500 EGP is the live store's threshold. It is a setting because it is a merchant decision that changes.

faq.name: Faq
faq.one_at_a_time_info: Uses the browser's own exclusive-accordion behaviour — no JavaScript involved.
faq.question: Question

featured_collections.name: Featured collections
featured_collections.spotlight_product_info: Used by the Spotlight layout. Falls back to the first product in the collection.

hero.autoplay_info: Off by default. Auto-advancing carousels are a WCAG 2.2.2 risk; rotation always stops on hover, on focus, and permanently once a control is used.
hero.name: Hero
hero.overlay_info: Check text contrast against the darkest point of the image, not the scrim colour.

image_text.name: Image text
image_text.parallax_info: Disabled automatically for reduced-motion users and coarse pointers.

instagram.info: Shopify has no first-party Instagram feed, so posts are merchant-picked images with links. That cannot break when a third-party token expires. instagram-assets/ holds 18 images of the real brand identity.
instagram.name: Instagram

logo_list.name: Logo list
logo_list.name_info: Used as the image's alt text. A logo with no name is unusable to a screen reader.

newsletter_popup.name: Newsletter popup
newsletter_popup.respect_close_info: Remembers a dismissal so the same visitor is not asked twice.

reviews.aggregate_info: Read live from Judge.me. Omitted rather than faked if unavailable — the figure moves (1,176 at the July capture, 1,212 in August).
reviews.authenticity_warning: ⚠ Featured review blocks must quote REAL reviews. These blocks exist so you can choose which genuine review to feature — typing an invented one fabricates an endorsement.
reviews.block_review_info: Quote a real review. Do not invent one.
reviews.name: Reviews

storytelling.caption: Caption
storytelling.name: Storytelling
storytelling.truth_warning: ⚠ This content must be true, and per the Kahina model, quantified — named partners, countable items, real percentages. Unquantified warmth is what the benchmark warns against.

video.autoplay_info: Muted and looping. Consider leaving off on mobile data.
video.name: Video

mood.info: Entry point into faceted browsing. The live store has no tag, vendor or size facets at all — configure them under Search & Discovery, then point these chips at the filtered URLs.
mood.label: Label
mood.label_info: Falls back to the collection title.
mood.name: Shop by mood
mood.show_counts_info: Counts are read live from the collection, never typed in — the captured counts in the audit are unreliable.
mood.url_info: Overrides the collection URL. Use a filtered collection URL to target a facet.

recent.candidate_limit_info: How many products are rendered hidden for filtering. 56 covers the whole catalogue.
recent.info: Hides itself when the visitor has no history, so a first-time visit shows nothing rather than an empty row. Handles are stored in localStorage on the visitor's own device; nothing is sent anywhere.
recent.name: Recently viewed
recent.source_info: Rendered hidden, then filtered client-side to what the visitor actually viewed. Leave empty to use all products. Point at a smaller collection on a large catalogue.

stay_close.info: Referral and newsletter side by side. WhatsApp leads deliberately — it is how this store actually talks to its customers.
stay_close.name: Stay close
stay_close.whatsapp_share_info: A wa.me link with your pre-filled message. The message is part of the URL, so it stays merchant-controlled and translatable.
